violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Interior of ice machine observed with discoloration and debris.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PIC agreed to clean and sanitized interior of ice machine.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: portioned ranch (49F) observed in cambro container at service line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC stated ranch was refilled ~1hr prior, ranch moved back to 1 Dr UCR unit to maintain temperature.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed boiled eggs (45F) and shred lettuce (48F) in the continental 3 DR prep.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded eggs, lettuce will be discarded in 4 hours of use.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present during this visit. The manager present stated he is in process of obtaining certification.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A follow up visit will be conducted to ensure a certified food manager is present.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the MILKSHAKE PREPARATION being used as a DUMPSINK. PIC STATED UPPER MANAGEMENT AND STERITECH INSTRUCTED ESTABLISHMENT TO UTILIZE HANDSINK AS A DUMPSINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. SINK BY APPROVED PLANS IS DESIGNATED AS A HANDWASHING SINK AND MAY NOT BE USED AS A DUMPSINK.
